skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Focus
skins.content: Test Collection Series/Focus. The attire Phantom wore when he left for the castle, and the costume for his maiden performance. After an age of gathering dust, it finally sees the light of day again.
skins.quote: Phantom's life is a play, but the members of the Troupe have no right to concern themselves with how it unfolds.

skins.name: Dream Within a Dreammare
skins.content: Clothes of Phantom's, the attire he sported while staffing the 'Dreambind Castle' event. The dance as cloth, the song as silk, the threading through emotion, the tailoring by fabrication, the weave of obliteration and howling madness, it all culminates in this majestic yet skin-crawling ensemble.
skins.quote: 'Pristine dreamscapes twine over the tangible in symbiosis, their fear and dread a permeation just begun. You outsiders, honored to take them on, are the first to do so—that live.'
